name: Al Riwaq Art Space

name: Mansudae Art Museum / Mansudae Art Studio Gallery, 798

name: Fabrika Centre for Creative Industries

name: Museum of West African Art (MOWAA)
watch: Oba loyalists disrupted the 9 November 2025 preview. Edo's Assembly urged a state takeover on 22 December 2025.

name: The Muse Multi Studios
watch: Opened Muse Gallery in Khartoum in 2022; since the April 2023 war it works between Sudan and Egypt and runs the Sudan Art Archive.
